summary: Alpex Acquisition Corporation filed a Form 8-K announcing the separate trading of its Class A ordinary shares, warrants, and rights, starting July 7, 2026. The units were previously sold in an IPO. No financial terms, premium, or board recommendation are involved; this is a routine post-IPO administrative step. The units trade on Nasdaq under ALPXU, and the components will trade separately under ALPX, ALPXW, and ALPXR. No special-situation catalyst is present; this filing is a standard operational update.
